verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented capability for AI to draft a written project or initiative status update from recent activity. The Rovo AI items are related but different features: automations and reminders that keep work-item status current, AI-assisted progress tracking from Slack, Figma and Gmail, and trend identification. None of them generates a status-update summary, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
